snippet.title: VR: Vacate the Room (official Trailer)
snippet.description:
Get it on Steam: http://store.steampowered.com/app/494810/VR_Vacate_the_Room/

VR: Vacate the Room is a short Escape the Room game.

It is a VR Experience where you need to find clues to solve puzzles and find your way out of the Room. There are some items that can be grabbed and carried around. With some items you can interact (such as switches and number pads).

#VirtualReality
